common.title: Report the casualty and sound the alarm
common.quote: Report the casualty, the space and any injuries to Damage Control Central and sound the alarm.

common.title: Account for all personnel
common.quote: Account for all personnel in and near the affected space.

confirm_location.title: Confirm the exact compartment
confirm_location.quote: Confirm the exact compartment before sending a response team.

steps.title: De-energize the circuit first
steps.quote: De-energize the affected circuit before anyone touches it or applies water.

steps.title: Keep personnel clear until confirmed dead
steps.quote: Keep personnel clear until the circuit is confirmed dead.

steps.title: Send the medical team
steps.quote: Send the medical team to the casualty.

steps.title: Move the injured only if the space is unsafe
steps.quote: Move an injured person only if the space is unsafe.

hazards.label: Toxic Gas
hazards.ask: What is the gas, and has the space been cleared?

steps.title: Evacuate, breathing protection for re-entry
steps.quote: Evacuate the space and require breathing protection before re-entry.

steps.title: Test the atmosphere before declaring safe
steps.quote: Test the atmosphere before declaring the space safe.

steps.title: Isolate the steam, clear the space
steps.quote: Isolate the steam source and clear personnel from the space.

hazards.label: Fuel Spill
hazards.ask: What is leaking, and how fast?

steps.title: Stop the leak at the isolation valve
steps.quote: Stop the leak at the nearest isolation valve.

steps.title: Remove ignition sources
steps.quote: Remove ignition sources from the area.

steps.title: Contain the spill, keep personnel clear
steps.quote: Contain the spill and keep personnel clear.

hazards.label: Fire
hazards.ask: What is burning, and what class of fire?

steps.title: Send the duty fire team
steps.quote: Send the duty fire team with the nearest approved extinguishing agent.

steps.title: Secure ventilation and power to the space
steps.quote: Secure ventilation and non-essential power to the affected space.

steps.title: Start {primary_pump}
steps.quote: Start the primary fire pump for the affected zone.

steps.title: Start {standby_pump}
steps.quote: If the primary fire pump is unavailable, start the standby fire pump.

steps.title: Start {emergency_pump}
steps.quote: If the standby fire pump is unavailable, start the emergency fire pump.

steps.title: Set fire boundaries
steps.quote: Set fire boundaries around the affected space.

hazards.label: Smoke
hazards.ask: Where is the smoke coming from?

steps.title: Treat smoke as fire until source is found
steps.quote: Treat smoke as a fire until the source is found.

steps.title: Require breathing protection in smoke
steps.quote: Require breathing protection for anyone entering smoke.

hazards.label: Flooding
hazards.ask: How fast is the water rising?

steps.title: Find the source, report the rate of rise
steps.quote: Find the source of the flooding and report the rate of rise.

steps.title: Secure power that could contact water
steps.quote: Secure electrical power that could contact the water.

steps.title: Start dewatering
steps.quote: Start dewatering with the nearest approved pump.

steps.title: Set flooding boundaries
steps.quote: Set flooding boundaries around the affected space.

steps.title: Report it, shift to the alternate source
steps.quote: Report the loss of power to the Bridge and shift to the alternate source.

steps.title: Shift steering, warn nearby traffic
steps.quote: Shift to the alternate steering station and warn nearby traffic.

step.title: Report magazine temperature, prepare sprinkling
step.quote: Report the magazine temperature and prepare the sprinkling system.

comms.speaker: Bridge
comms.text: {hazard}, {hazard}, {hazard}. {hazard} reported in {location}. All hands stand clear of {location}.

comms.speaker: Damage Control Central
comms.text: Bridge, DCC. {hazard_list} reported in {location}. Response team is being sent. {status}

comms.speaker: Damage Control Central
comms.text: Repair locker, DCC. Investigate {location}. Report what you find. {status}
